description: Opt-in GHC updates for Haskell libraries: exact tested-with versions and ghc/ghc annotations, each kept within its series.

customManagers.description: Each exact GHC version in tested-with, whose items follow the field name, a comma, a || or a line break

packageRules.description: Each GHC version moves only within its series; a library adds a new series by hand. Release tags wrap the version as ghc-X.Y.Z-release.
